newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Polifin gets 285 mln rand Secunda expansion.
newsitem.headline: Polifin gets 285 mln rand Secunda expansion.

text.p: South African chemicals firm Polifin Ltd said on Monday that it had got board approval for a 285 million rand expansion at two plants at its Secunda site.

The move is part of the second phase of a plan that will see polypropylene production at the plant jump from 140,000 tonnes a year to at least 220,000 tonnes, Polifin said in a statment. The investment will go towards Secunda's polypropylene and propylene purification plants.
The additional production will be surplus to local requirements and the extra polypropylene will be exported.
Phase I of the the whole expansion project involved modifying the plant using new catalyst technology and debottlenecking the existing purification facility.
The phase was completed two months ahead of schedule for 75 million rand.
Phase II is to see upgrading of major plant equipment as well as building a new purification plant. It is scheduled for completion by January, 1999.
